newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds end with scattered trades in soy.
newsitem.headline: European feeds end with scattered trades in soy.

text.p: European meals and feeds closed with scattered nearby trades on Friday but nervousness over near-term market direction continued to linger, hampering activity, traders said.
Traders reported the business in Argentine soymeal, with afloat and summer month positions the most active.
But Chicago's susceptibility to wild weather-related swings and the strong dollar were enough to keep buying limited.
"We've got a very nervous market here, but it's without direction and without volume. Nobody knows what will happen with crop development," one said.--Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
